js: const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==='Add Food'); if(!b) return 'no add'; b.click(); return 'open'
const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>/manual entry/i.test(x.innerText)); if(!b) return 'no manual'; if(b.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true') b.click(); return 'manual'

const i=document.getElementById('calories'); if(!i) return 'no cal'; const s=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; s.call(i,'400'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return {cal:i.value, name:(document.getElementById('food_name')||{}).value}
const bs=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Add Food'); const b=bs[bs.length-1]; b.click(); return bs.length

const t=document.body.innerText; const i=t.indexOf('Remaining'); return {quickRows:(t.match(/Quick add\n\d/g)||[]).length, planned:/planned/i.test(t), ring:t.slice(i,i+120), undo:!!Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Undo'), toast:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-sonner-toast]')).map(x=>x.innerText)}
const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Undo'); if(!b) return 'no undo'; b.click(); return 'undo'
